assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.bookofdragons.config.speedfov.tooltip: Dynamically widens the field of view at high flight speeds to enhance the sensation of velocity.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.bookofdragons.config.ridingcamera.toolti: Default camera perspective when mounting a dragon. First Person places the camera at the saddle; Third Person places the camera behind the dragon.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.bookofdragons.config.remembercamera.tool: When ON, restores the last camera perspective used while riding instead of always switching to the configured default on mount.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.bookofdragons.config.sprintmode.tooltip: Controls how the sprint key works while riding. Hold: sprint while the key is held. Toggle: press once to start, press again to stop.

assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.message.dragon.needs_saddle: Dragon needs a saddle to be ridden!
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.index.intro: In your hands you hold the ultimate source of knowledge on the dragons of Berk. The Dragon Manual! Everything we know about every dragon we know of.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.tamed.none: You have not yet tamed any dragons. Bond with a dragon to see it recorded here.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.tamed.intro: First you have to get their attention. Then you need to earn their trust. Everyone wonders what it's like to fly, now it's your turn to unlock the skies!
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.nightfury.des: The unholy offspring of lightning and death itself. Never engage this dragon. Your only chance: Hide and pray it does not find you.
The rarest and most intelligent of the dragon species, the Night Fury is distinguished by its usual dark color and piercing, vibrant eyes.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.nightfury.hab: Found in remote mountain peaks and coastal cliffs. Roosts in shadowed crevices.
Loyal Night Furies follow their rider everywhere, but prefer high-altitude perches for rest and respite.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.nightfury.die: Mainly a fisheater, but is known to rip appart vikings with ease.
Loves salmon above all else. Accepts tropical fish as a special treat, and eats cod regularly.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.deadly_nadder: A vain and aggressive dragon with a keen sense of smell. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
Affectionate and energetic once tamed. Deadly Nadders are eager to please and proud to show off for their rider.
Known to prowl temperate forests and glades.
Prefers open meadows and forested areas, but is very attached to its rider, following them anywhere.
Has been known to eat fish in large amounts, but doesn't shy away from a viking dessert.
Has a high preference for chicken, and enjoys tropical fish as a special treat.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.monstrous_nig: Only the best Vikings go after these. Beware their nasty habit of setting themselves on fire. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
Fiercely loyal once its trust is earned. A powerful combat companion that fights with reckless ferocity for its rider.
Has been seen in volcanic regions and arid barrens with high ambient temperatures.
Prefers warm, open areas, but is loyal enough to accompany its rider even through the cold wastes of Helheim.
Known to eat fish, but seems to prefer red meat above all.
Loves beef, with a side of tropical fish as a coveted special treat.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.gronckle.desc: This Dragon is not built for speed, but it can fly like a hummingbird. A giant, stubborn hummingbird that shoots lava rocks. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
Slow-moving but endearing. Gronckles are lazy, and spend most of their time sleeping in communal heaps.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.gronckle.habi: Found in rocky caves and communal roosts. Prefers enclosed spaces with mineral deposits for consumption.
Happiest near stone, caves, or rocky outcroppings close to their rider. Enjoys chewing on the odd minerals.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.gronckle.diet: Eats from fish to rocks, with vikings in between.
Has a special taste for mutton, but can be fed some special minerals to produce something even more special.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.hideous_zippl: Two heads, twice the trouble. One releases gas, the other ignites it. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
A surprisingly cooperative companion once trained. The two heads require patience but can become an incredible companion.
Prefers damp, humid environments. Enjoys bodies of water and shaded forest areas, but always follows its rider regardless of peril.
Both head rarely agree, but fish is always a consensus. And the odd confused viking, of course.
Loves salmon. Pufferfish is a highly prized special treat for both heads.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.skrill.descri: This elusive creature is highly secretive and is known to ride lightning bolts. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
Wild and proud, a tamed Skrill is an unparalleled partner. Its lightning strikes on command — but its trust must be earned.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.skrill.habita: Found in high mountain ranges and rarely during thunderstorms.
Enjoys elevated perches and open skies during storms. Thrives during thunderstorms alongside its rider.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.skrill.diet.w: Primarily eats fish, striking fast and precise like a lightning bolt.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.skrill.diet.t: Loves mutton above all, but enjoys tropical fish as a special treat.
assets/bookofdragons/lang/en_us.json.book.bookofdragons.species.whispering_de: A subterranean nightmare, with rows of rotating teeth that bore through solid rock. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
A fierce but loyal underground guardian when bonded. Its tunneling ability makes it invaluable in the right situations.
Lives deep underground in mazes it digs with its teeth. Occasionally surfaces through cave networks.
Still prefers underground or shaded environments. Given the chance, will tunnel to close the distance to its rider, or targets.
Primarily eats fish, but is known to swallow unwary vikings whole.
Loves mutton. Rabbit is its preferred special treat.

assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.rarity.celestial.name: Celestial
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.block.celestisynth.no_more_celestial_wor: This item is no longer usable. Please convert this block into the Starlit Factory in the crafting grid!
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.shift_notice: [Press Shift or Ctrl to switch pages]
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.solar_crystal_armor_bo: When receiving damage, the armor burst out a circle of flame, dealing damage and burning surrounding targets. Each piece increases the damage of the burst and the duration of the fire.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.lunar_stone_armor_bonu: When the wearer is hurt, the armor has a 1/5 chance to significantly reduce the damage received. Each piece increases the damage reduction value.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.tip.celestisynth.starlit_factory_0: Did you know? The Rainfall Serenity is enchantable with some crossbow enchantments like Multishot, Piercing, and Quick Charge?
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.tip.celestisynth.starlit_factory_1: The Poltergeist is one extremely powerful heavy hitter, you just gotta use it right!
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.tip.celestisynth.starlit_factory_2: Blood Monoliths naturally spawn on nether fortresses, so watch out for Traversers! They're quick, cautious, and versatile!
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.tip.celestisynth.starlit_factory_3: Have you ever wondered what a PvP would look like with these weapons? Well, I do.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.tip.celestisynth.starlit_factory_4: The Keres is the most destructive weapon in the mod, use it with caution!
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.effect.celestisynth.hellbane.description: Increases any regeneration effects affecting the entity
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.effect.celestisynth.cursebane.descriptio: Decreases any regeneration effects affecting the entity
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.enchantment.celestisynth.pulsation.desc: Has a chance of causing an additional on-hit pulse that applies knockback and extra damage
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.rapid_player_attack: %s was damaged by %s repeatedly until death.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.rapid_player_attack_nokb: %s was damaged by %s repeatedly until death.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.pulsation: %s gave %s a massive flash of power.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.solaris.passive_desc_1: The player gains fire immunity while holding the item - normal attacks with this item sets the target on fire for a few seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.solaris.passive_desc_2: When holding the right-button with the Solaris, the player can summon up to 5 solar bombs that will circle around them. Hurting a target redirects a solar bomb to them.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.solaris.desc_1: Perform a graceful spin, inflicting damage and burning nearby entities.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.solaris.desc_2: Dash forward, striking and temporarily igniting entities in your path.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.crescentia.passive_des: The player gains a level of damage resistance while holding the item - normal attacks with this item slows down the target for a few seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.crescentia.desc_1: Unleash a dazzling barrage of strikes on nearby entities, accompanied by a mesmerizing firework display.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.crescentia.desc_2: Unleash a set of dragon-like projectiles, dragging enemies along with it whilst continuously slashing them.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.passive_: The player gains a huge jump boost and fall damage immunity while holding the item, but takes 2.3x damage from all the other damage sources.
Every 15 skill casts activate or deactivate this passive. While active, the player gains a speed boost and reduces skill cooldowns by half. The effect wears off after 8 seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.desc_1: Unleashes a powerful wind slash that inflicts tremendous damage upon impact.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.conditio: Activate: Hold Right-click for 0.5 or more seconds
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.desc_2: Executes Galestorm twice consecutively, overwhelming foes with a relentless onslaught of wind slashes.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.desc_3: Summons a destructive tornado that slices through any entities unfortunate enough to cross its path.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.desc_4: Swiftly dashes forward, inflicting massive damage to the first entity it encounters along the way.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.desc_5: Creates a towering vertical wheel of wind around the player, obliterating nearby entities with its devastating force.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.poltergeist.passive_de: All skills of this weapon tags every affected entity with a Phantom Tag. Slain foes with the tag become monstrous Aberrants that draw in nearby entities for 5 seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.poltergeist.desc_1: Executes a smash to the ground, dealing massive burst damage on surrounding entities. After 10 consecutive strikes, the weapon enables it's "Aberrant Form", allowing the next strike to enlarge and mutate a sucking aberrant from the ground. Killing an entity during "Aberrant Form" or jumping midair while striking instantly resets the cooldown of this ability.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.poltergeist.desc_2: Creates a protective barrier capable of shattering any incoming projectiles while forcefully propelling the player backwards.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.advancement.celestisynth.obtain_aquaflor: When the flowers bloom that day
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.passive_desc: Every skill cast gives 3 seconds of speed to the caster.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_1: Launches a series of attacks capable of penetrating a row of entities.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_2: Uses a head-butt against a group of entities, pushing them away and inflicting significant damage. Activating this ability initiates the Blooming State, altering the weapon's skill set.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_3: During the execution of this skill, the player becomes immune to damage while delivering up to 20 individual attacks on entities within range. Dual wielding the same weapon enables the player to perform up to 40+ attacks, albeit with decreased damage.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.condition_4: Activate: Right-click while holding SHIFT during Blooming State
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_4: The player executes a backward dash, leaving a floral effect that draws nearby entities toward it. This ability deactivates the Blooming State, resulting in a modification of the weapon's skill set.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.skil: Eons, and Eons Through the Sky
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.desc: When the bow is released, it emits a laser that can pierce through every entity, marking each with a "Quasar Mark" for 5 seconds. This mark can trigger nearby entities to shoot lasers at the marked target.
When the laser strikes a target with a "Quasar Mark", a portal spawns above and lasers will rain down around the target.
Increases speed massively and activates "True Invisibility" for 5 seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.cond: Activate: Drop item on solid platform
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.desc: Dropping this item on to a solid platform transforms this weapon into a turret that shoots anything nearby.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.frostbound.passive_des: Inflicting harm upon a target using this weapon induces a frostbound condition, significantly diminishing their strength and reducing their speed.
When holding the right-button with the Frostbound, the weapon consumes Frostbound Shards and shoots them out towards nearby random entities, freezing them for a few seconds.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.frostbound.desc_1: Executes a rhythmic movement sequence that inflicts damage on nearby entities multiple times, afflicting them with a frostbound effect.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.frostbound.desc_2: Calls forth a maximum of five sizable ice formations in front of the caster, causing damage to entities and bestowing upon them a frostbound effect.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_1: After consecutively attacking targets 5 times in a row, the holder activates a Hellbane state - which increases the Keres' lifesteal and repeatedly ejects homing shadow projectiles towards nearby enemies.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_2: While using the Keres to cast a skill, the holder sacrifices 1.5 health every few seconds, but every single skill regenerates the holder's health to some degree when it lands on a target.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_3: When a skill hit a target, it gives a Cursebane effect to the target for 5 seconds. The effect reduces the healing rate of the target significantly.
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.desc_1: Sends waves of slashes that bypasses armor. The amount of slashes is proportional to the degree of "Weapon-Consumed Blood".
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.desc_2: Jumps to a location and sends a shockwave to the surroundings. The jumping distance is proportional to the degree of "Weapon-Consumed Blood".
assets/celestisynth/lang/en_us.json.item.celestisynth.keres.condition_3: Hold Right-click for 10 or more seconds

assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.angler_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Deep Waters. Can be fed shiny items to be granted with Night Vision. Deflates on Land. Fits in a bucket.

It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.

assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.barnacle_cluster: A block of Reefstone overgrown with barnacles. Spreads more barnacles if underwater and not clogged.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.sea_urchin: A sea floor dwelling prickly animal that dies out of water. Can carry an item on its head. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dead_sea_urchin: A sea floor dwelling animal that dried out from being placed out of water.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.sea_urchin: %1$s was poked to death by a sea urchin
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.sea_urchin.item: %1$s was poked to death by a sea urchin whilst trying to hurt %2$s and avoiding %3$s
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.death.attack.sea_urchin.player: %1$s was poked to death by a sea urchin whilst trying to hurt %2$s
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.sea_star: A sea floor dwelling animal that dies out of water. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dead_sea_star: A sea floor dwelling animal that dried out from being placed out of water.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.sea_bunny: A sea floor dwelling animal found in Tide Pools. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.broad_grass: A broad leaf plant found in tropical regions.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.tropical_wildflowers: A flowerbed block found in Tropical Islands that can be grown with Bone Meal or crafted into Red dye.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.fieldguide.spawn.date_sapling.descriptio: Found in Tropical islands, date trees often sport date bunches, which are collected both in a traditional way and with the use of projectiles.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.date_leaves: A natural block that forms the canopy of a Date tree.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dangling_date_leaves: A natural block that forms the canopy of a Date tree.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.date_bunch: A group of dates grown from a Date tree. Can be broken with Projectiles.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dates: A fruit that comes from a Date tree. Can be eaten for a small amount of saturation or turned into a Date seed.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.date_cookie: A cookie that restores a small amount of saturation.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.coastal_crab.description: A neutral mob found in coastal regions that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.coastal_crab_bucket: A bucket with a Coastal Crab inside.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.coastal_crab_claw: A claw from a Coastal Crab, can shoot Bubbles that carry entities at the cost of water.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.crab_boil_block: A feast made of boiled crab, bacon and potatoes. Can be eaten with a bowl.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.crab_boil: A plate that restores a good amount of saturation.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.crab_bubble.description: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.spider_crab.description: An aquatic hostile mob that spawns in Cold Oceans and can jump, climb walls and shoot frozen bubbles.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.stranded.description: An ambient passive mob that attacks hostiles that bump into it. Can be turned on and off by waxing.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.barbed.description: An aquatic neutral mob found in Warmer Oceans that only attacks players in water. Shoots exploding Barbs.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.barb.description: An underwater entity that explodes when collided with.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.frozen_crab_bubble.descript: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.music_disc_barbaric: A music disc that can be collected by getting a Barbed to kill a Creeper, and can be played in a Jukebox. It's an uncommon find.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.iguana.description: A passive mob found on Tropical Islands that can absorb sunrays and use them to cook items. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.sneezed_salt.description: A clump of salt shot at a high velocity.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.marine_iguana.description: A passive mob found on sea stacks. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.iguana_egg: An egg that will eventually hatch into a Baby Iguana.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.marine_iguana_egg: An egg that will eventually hatch into a baby Marine Iguana.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.spawn.mob_perching.onboard: Press %1$s in the air to let go of %2$s
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.seal.description: A passive mob found on Cold islands and in Frozen Oceans. Can hitch you a ride at the cost of live fish. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.baby_seal_bucket: A bucket with a baby Seal inside.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.advancements.spawn.get_advancement_near_: Gain an advancement near a seal
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.painting.spawn.clown.title: Clown
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.painting.spawn.clown.author: Ninni
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.booby.description: A passive mob found on Sandy Islands that performs mating dances and mates for life.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.booby_egg: An item that can be thrown and crafted into food items. Boobies drop it after successfully bred.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.booby_egg_shard: A crafting ingredient that sometimes drops from a thrown Booby Egg.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.blue_footed_boots: A pair of boots that aid in swimming, jumping and are so big they leave behind footprints.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.advancements.spawn.discover_booby.title: My Eyes are up Here
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.dodo.description: A passive defenseless mob found on Dodo islands that shoots harmless seeds at hostile mobs. It's incapable of breeding and swimming and oblivious to danger.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.melon_seed.description: A melon seed spat out at a high velocity. It's too small to deal meaningful damage.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dodo_translator: A one per world helment that, when worn, allows the wearer to understand Dodos.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.dodo: A meat that can be eaten raw but should really be cooked. Dropped by Dodos.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.cooked_dodo: A meat that restores your full saturation and absorption bar.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.music_disc_dally: A one per world music disc that can be played in a Jukebox.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.painting.spawn.its_still_life.title: It's Still Life
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.painting.spawn.its_still_life.author: Ninni
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.fly_bottle: An item that can be thrown. It transfers Flies to the closest target.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.zombified_flower: A putrid flower that attracts Flies. Can be crafted into Rotten Flesh.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.blasted_sand: A black colored sand that can be found in volcanic areas, and smelted into Glass. It is affected by gravity.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.blasted_sandstone: A block that makes an excellent building material, as it is not affected by gravity.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.chiseled_blasted_sandstone: A block of Blasted Sandstone with a chiseled pattern.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.cut_blasted_sandstone: A block of Blasted Sandstone that has been cut. Unlike Blasted Sand, it isn't affected by gravity.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.smooth_blasted_sandstone: A block of Blasted Sandstone that has been perfectly smelted to a point where it has become perfectly smooth.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.sunstone: A block that yields the power of the sun. It can be offered as fuel for Volcanoes.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.moonstone: A block that yields the power of the moon. It can be offered as an offering for Volcanoes.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.heart_of_the_sun: A block at the core of a volcano, it's capable of erupting and accepting offerings.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.heliostone: A volcanic block that starts melting when near heat sources. Can be renewed by Sunstones.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.magmatic_splatter: A volcanic block that coats surfaces in magma, setting anything that touches it on fire.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.lore.spawn.unstable_heliostone: A volcanic block shot out during eruptions. It can yield useful minerals.
assets/spawn/lang/en_us.json.entity.spawn.firekeeper.description: A hostile mob made of molten rock and sunstone that can attack from long and close range.

assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.1: Forged beneath a sun that never rose,
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.2: this blade was carried by the Ashen King.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.3: His final charge still burns within its edge.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_talisman.1: A wandering sage bound eight storm-splinters
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_talisman.2: with a vow written on humble paper.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_talisman.3: The sky still listens when the seal is broken.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.thunderclap_blade.1: The sky-forger quenched this blade in thunder.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.thunderclap_blade.2: One stroke divided a mountain and its shadow.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.thunderclap_blade.3: The scar remains; the forger does not.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_shard.1: A splinter from the spear of the storm god.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_shard.2: It fell when heaven cracked above the sea,
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_shard.3: and has never forgotten the thunder.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_talisman.1: The last sun-priest sealed a stolen dawn
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_talisman.2: inside this golden leaf. Its embers remember
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_talisman.3: the kingdom that vanished beneath the ash.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.sword_intent.1: A nameless swordsman asked the last dragon
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.sword_intent.2: for no treasure, only its final breath.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.sword_intent.3: From that silence, a thousand blades awoke.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.air_talisman.1: The sky hermit hid the first wind
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.air_talisman.2: inside a pale shell. When it opens,
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.air_talisman.3: even the mountains forget their weight.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.guardian_charm.1: An ancient guardian wrote one vow
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.guardian_charm.2: in gold upon a scarlet leaf.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.guardian_charm.3: No blade shall end the life it shelters.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.priori_incantatem.1: The last scribe sealed a single silence
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.lore.flametalisman.priori_incantatem.3: Even forbidden stars obey its final word.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.tooltip.flametalisman.heart_skill: Right-click: a torrent of 50 silver-blue swords.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.tooltip.flametalisman.heart_cost: Cost: 1 durability and 30% maximum health; level 100 is free.

assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.air_push.descr: Ask everyone nearby to stand somewhere else.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.air_vortex.des: Put the neighborhood through the spin cycle.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.celestial_swor: Order one enormous sword. Delivery from above.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.divine_encount: Meet a Lord of Swords within 64 blocks.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.fire_ritual.de: Call down a sky full of golden fire.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_air_talism: Acquire the Air Talisman. Gravity has been muted.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_flame_blad: Acquire the Flame Blade. Dinner is now well done.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_flame_tali: A sheet of paper. A remarkably bad fire-safety policy.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_guardian_c: Acquire the Guardian Charm. Not a good day to get hurt.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_heart_of_s: Claim a Heart of Swords from the sword master.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_lightning_: Pick up a little piece of very bad weather.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_sword_inte: Acquire Sword Intent. The sky will make room.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_thundercla: The forecast is now your responsibility.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_time_altar: Build a Time Altar. Some prices cannot be paid in gold.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_time_scrol: Offer your time and claim a Time Talisman.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.level_100.desc: Reach level 100. Forbidden magic without the bill.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.root.title: Super-Tier Magic
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.sword_domain.d: Fill your personal space with a small army of swords.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.thunder_ritual: Ask the heavens for a very loud second opinion.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.tooltip.flametalisman.altar_ward: Leave to claim a duration-scaled talisman; three days auto-settles. Standing sustains a protective ward.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.message.flametalisman.ancient_scroll: A scroll steeped in history. It seems to seal a terrifying power between heaven and earth!
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_ancient_sc: Obtain an Ancient Scroll. Some pages were never meant to turn.
assets/flametalisman/lang/en_us.json.advancement.flametalisman.kill_ancient_z: Defeat an Ancient Zombie. The past has rather sharp teeth.
Lock a creature and send a white sword torrent from the heavens behind you.

assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.1: 铸于未曾升起的烈日之下，
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.2: 此刀曾随灰烬之王远征。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_blade.3: 他最后的冲锋，仍燃于刃中。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_talisman.3: 符印一开，长天仍会应答。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.thunderclap_blade.2: 一刀分开山岳与它的影子。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_shard.1: 雷神长矛崩落的一枚碎片。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.lightning_shard.3: 它至今未曾忘记那声雷鸣。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_talisman.1: 最后的日祭司偷来一缕黎明，
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.flame_talisman.3: 那个消失于灰中的国度。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.sword_intent.3: 万剑自那片寂静中苏醒。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.air_talisman.3: 壳启之时，群山亦忘其重。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.guardian_charm.1: 古老的守护者将一句誓言，
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.guardian_charm.2: 以金墨写在朱红符纸上。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.priori_incantatem.1: 最后的书吏封存了一声寂静，
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.lore.flametalisman.priori_incantatem.3: 禁术之星，亦须听其终言。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.tooltip.flametalisman.heart_skill: 右键：持续齐射 50 把银蓝飞剑。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.tooltip.flametalisman.heart_cost: 基础消耗 1 点耐久及最大生命值的 30%；100 级免费。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.tooltip.flametalisman.time_players: 结束后立即恢复；玩家不受暂停影响

assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.time_cancel: 时间法术已被解除，流速恢复正常。

assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.offering_start: 你开始了时间献祭仪式。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.offering_end: 你结束了时间献祭仪式。再次站上祭坛将重新计时。

assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.offering_night: 时间献祭：又献出了半个昼夜。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.offering_reward: 你献祭了自己的 %s 天时间，获得奇物：时间符箓（时长 %s 秒）
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.offering_restart: 本轮时间献祭已完成，你仍站在祭坛上：新一轮时间献祭仪式已经开启。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.saint_falls: 圣者 %s 陨落，还道于天
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.abyss.title: 小心脚下
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.abyss.descript: 斩出深渊。请勿跨越黄线。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.air_push.title: 请退后
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.air_vortex.des: 让周围的生物体验旋转程序。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.celestial_swor: 订购一柄巨剑，由天空配送。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.divine_encount: 在 64 格内首次遇见一位剑圣。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_air_talism: 得到御气符。重力暂时静音。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_flame_blad: 得到火焰刀。今晚吃几分熟？
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_flame_tali: 得到火焰符。防火守则暂且搁下。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_guardian_c: 得到护身符。今日不宜受伤。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_heart_of_s: 从剑圣处获得通明剑心。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_priori_inc: 得到万咒皆终。诸法皆寂。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_sword_inte: 得到通明剑意。长天自会让路。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_thundercla: 得到奔雷刀。天气预报由你负责。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_time_altar: 建造时间祭坛。有些代价，黄金付不起。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_time_scrol: 献出时间，获得时间符箓。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.level_100.desc: 达到 100 级。禁咒不再附带账单。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.root.title: 超位魔法
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.root.descripti: 小小器物，足以惊动天地。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.sword_domain.d: 用一支飞剑大军填满私人空间。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.thunder_ritual: 请苍穹发表一点响亮的意见。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.tooltip.flametalisman.altar_ward: 离开时按献祭时长结算符箓；满三天自动结算。站立期间展开防护结界。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.message.flametalisman.ancient_scroll: 这是一张充满历史痕迹的卷轴，似乎封印着天地间大恐怖力量！
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.get_ancient_sc: 得到远古卷轴。有些书页，最好不要翻开。
assets/flametalisman/lang/zh_cn.json.advancement.flametalisman.kill_ancient_z: 击败一只远古僵尸。看来往事也会咬人。
锁定生物，让身后万剑尽赴一念。

mods.description:
Minecraft is great game, but exploring always felt a bit boring for us.
        There aren't many structures or dungeons you can explore and the ones you find, are getting repetitive.
        We decided to spice things up a bit, by adding new dungeons and structures for you to explore.
        By now 27 new dungeons and structures are included in our mod.
        They all fit a medieval/fantasy theme and could fit along other fantasy or RPG-like Mods.
        Some of our structures also look like they could be an upgraded version of a vanilla structure or a variant to them.
        Get ready to find huge mazes under trees, castles, towers and forgotten temples.
        We hope you have fun!

mods.description:
With this Mod your Hotbar items will be visible on your Character, with a unique location for a your Shield, Banner and offhand item.

You can turn on or off the visibility for all of them one-by-one.

There you can set things like rotation, position, size, etc.

If the item you want to show up is not visible by default then you have to add it to your whitelist or
if there is an item you dont want to show up then add it to your blacklist.

You can change the position, rotation, size of the items by default in the detailed window.
If you dont like the item settings then you can change that items pos, rot, size in the unique item settings window.

More info at website.

If you find any errors please let me know.
You can find me on curseforge: YourDailyModderx
or
Write in the discord server:
https://discord.gg/FcD5KwQXSK

Thanks for downloading my mod!
